notes.title: New update on August 1!
notes.notes:
We follow your wishes and comments in Steam discussions, so we prepared a new update where we tried to take into account most of it.

Changes:

 Get rid of invisible enemies 
 Enemies no longer attack when you open game windows 
 Fixed bugs with getting diamonds 
 Change of save date after overriding the current save 
 Forbidden to swim on land on a raft
